newplants.researcher_notes: The Mississippi Department of Environmental Quality posted a public notice dated September 9, 2026. The JAN250 Site at 1001 Industrial Park Drive in Clinton, Hinds County, asked for an optional pre-permit construction approval for a data center. The data center would have emergency back-up generators with a total power capacity of approximately 250 megawatts and diesel fuel storage tanks. The notice does not name the company. The state air permit database page for the same address lists the facility as Amazon Data Services, with air construction permit file 1080-00275 and a comment period that ended on September 21, 2026. I did not find the draft permit itself. Guessed document addresses failed, and the saved copies of the public notice page on the Wayback Machine do not include this notice. The point is a street search result for Industrial Park Drive in Clinton and is approximate. The Census geocoder placed a different road name about 2 kilometers away, so I did not use it. Not found: the number of generators, the size of each, the start year and the exact site.
newplants.action: Create the plant in Hinds County, Mississippi, with owner Amazon Data Services Inc, then add the unit below. Move the point onto the site if a person can see it on the map.

verifications.note: Mississippi air permit 1720-00098 for Amazon Data Services in Canton, issued 2024-12-04 and modified 2025-12-16. It lists each generator with its kW rating.

newunits.note: The Mississippi air permit for the Canton site lists 10 smaller generators that GEM does not carry. Five house generators are 750 kilowatts each, two water treatment generators are 1,500 kilowatts each, and three building generators are 400, 400 and 250 kilowatts. Together they are 7.8 megawatts. The permit lists them in addition to the 326 large generators that GEM already has as Unit 1. Ridgeland and Meridian already show their small generators as a separate unit, so this follows the same pattern. Not found: the exact start date for these generators.
newunits.researcher_notes: The Mississippi Department of Environmental Quality air permit 1720-00098 for Amazon Data Services at Canton was issued on December 4, 2024 and modified on December 16, 2025. It lists 326 critical generators of 2,750 kilowatts each, which is 896.5 megawatts and matches GEM Unit 1. It also lists 5 house generators of 750 kilowatts, 2 water treatment generators of 1,500 kilowatts, 2 generators of 400 kilowatts and 1 of 250 kilowatts. Those 10 generators sum to 7.8 megawatts and are not in GEM. The permit total is 336 engines and 904.3 megawatts.
newunits.action: Add Unit 2 to the Canton plant as a diesel internal combustion unit of 7.8 MW with 10 engines, status construction, Backup Power yes, captive power for a data center.
